purpose: Validate that a Super Admin can successfully create a new hostel master record.
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated and has no existing hostel with the same identifier.
action_or_input: Submit a create‑hostel request with valid hostel details.
expected_result: System creates the hostel record and returns a success confirmation.

purpose: Ensure Super Admin can bind a Warden role to a hostel.
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated; hostel record exists; Warden user exists.
action_or_input: Assign the Warden role to the hostel via the role‑binding interface.
expected_result: Role binding is recorded and the Warden gains access to hostel‑specific functions.

purpose: Verify that a Student can view their current room allocation.
preconditions: Student is logged in and has an active room assignment.
action_or_input: Navigate to the "Room Allocation" view.
expected_result: The interface displays the student's current room details.

purpose: Confirm that a Student can submit a new accommodation request.
preconditions: Student is authenticated and has no pending request.
action_or_input: Fill and submit the accommodation request form with valid data.
expected_result: System records the request and returns a submission acknowledgment.

purpose: Validate room‑vacation update by Super Admin.
preconditions: Super Admin authenticated; room currently occupied.
action_or_input: Mark the room as vacant through the room‑management UI.
expected_result: Room status changes to vacant and occupancy count is decremented.

purpose: Check that a Student can view historical room allocation records.
preconditions: Student authenticated; student has past room assignments.
action_or_input: Access the "Allocation History" section.
expected_result: A list of previous room assignments is displayed.

purpose: Ensure that a Student can submit a leave request.
preconditions: Student logged in; no existing pending leave request.
action_or_input: Complete and submit the leave request form with valid dates.
expected_result: Leave request is recorded and a confirmation is shown.

purpose: Validate that a caretaker can approve a leave request.
preconditions: Caretaker authenticated; a pending leave request exists.
action_or_input: Approve the pending leave request via the approval interface.
expected_result: Leave request status changes to Approved and the student is notified.

purpose: Confirm that a caretaker can reject a leave request.
preconditions: Caretaker logged in; pending leave request present.
action_or_input: Reject the leave request providing a rejection reason.
expected_result: Leave request status changes to Rejected and the student receives the reason.

purpose: Verify successful approval of a room re‑allocation request.
preconditions: Super Admin authenticated; re‑allocation request pending approval.
action_or_input: Approve the re‑allocation request.
expected_result: Room assignments are updated according to the request and a success message is shown.

purpose: Verify that a rejected re‑allocation request leaves assignments unchanged.
preconditions: Super Admin authenticated; re‑allocation request pending.
action_or_input: Reject the request with a justification.
expected_result: No changes to room assignments; request status becomes Rejected and reason is recorded.

purpose: Ensure that a student can view a guest‑room booking form.
preconditions: Student logged in; guest‑room feature enabled.
action_or_input: Navigate to the "Guest Room Booking" page.
expected_result: The booking form is displayed with available dates and rooms.

purpose: Validate that a student can submit a guest‑room booking.
preconditions: Student authenticated; valid booking details entered.
action_or_input: Submit the guest‑room booking request.
expected_result: Booking is recorded, room availability is updated, and confirmation is shown.

purpose: Confirm that a caretaker can resolve a complaint.
preconditions: Caretaker logged in; complaint in 'Open' state.
action_or_input: Mark the complaint as Resolved with a resolution note.
expected_result: Complaint status becomes Resolved and the student receives notification.

purpose: Verify that a caretaker can update complaint details.
preconditions: Caretaker authenticated; complaint exists.
action_or_input: Edit the complaint description and save.
expected_result: Complaint information is updated and audit trail records the change.

purpose: Check that a caretaker can escalate a complaint to a higher authority.
preconditions: Caretaker logged in; complaint requires escalation.
action_or_input: Escalate the complaint, optionally adding comments.
expected_result: Complaint status changes to Escalated and senior staff are notified.

purpose: Validate that a Super Admin can generate a hostel occupancy report.
preconditions: Super Admin authenticated.
action_or_input: Request the occupancy report for a given date range.
expected_result: System returns a report containing current occupancy statistics.

purpose: Ensure that a caretaker can record a fine for a student.
preconditions: Caretaker logged in; student has an infraction.
action_or_input: Create a fine entry with amount and reason for the student.
expected_result: Fine is stored, student balance updates, and a notification is sent.

purpose: Verify approval of a fine payment by the student.
preconditions: Student authenticated; outstanding fine exists.
action_or_input: Submit payment for the fine and confirm.
expected_result: Fine status changes to Paid and receipt is generated.

purpose: Validate handling of a failed fine payment.
preconditions: Student authenticated; fine pending payment.
action_or_input: Attempt payment with insufficient funds.
expected_result: Payment fails, fine remains Unpaid, and an error message is shown.

purpose: Confirm that a caretaker can view guard shift schedules.
preconditions: Caretaker logged in.
action_or_input: Open the "Guard Shift" schedule page.
expected_result: Schedule list with shift times and assigned guards is displayed.

purpose: Validate that a caretaker can add a new guard shift.
preconditions: Caretaker authenticated; shift details prepared.
action_or_input: Create a new guard shift entry with date, time, and guard name.
expected_result: Shift is saved and appears in the schedule list.

purpose: Verify that a Super Admin can approve a new hostel activation request.
preconditions: Super Admin logged in; activation request pending.
action_or_input: Approve the activation request.
expected_result: Hostel status changes to Active and a confirmation is sent.

purpose: Verify that a Super Admin can reject a hostel activation request.
preconditions: Super Admin authenticated; activation request pending.
action_or_input: Reject the request with a reason.
expected_result: Hostel remains Inactive; request status becomes Rejected and reason recorded.

purpose: Ensure that a Student can view hostel notices.
preconditions: Student logged in.
action_or_input: Navigate to the "Notices" section.
expected_result: List of current hostel notices is displayed.

purpose: Validate that a Super Admin can post a new hostel notice.
preconditions: Super Admin authenticated.
action_or_input: Create a notice with title and content and publish.
expected_result: Notice appears in the notices list for all students.

purpose: Confirm that a caretaker can acknowledge a student complaint.
preconditions: Caretaker logged in; complaint in 'New' state.
action_or_input: Mark the complaint as Acknowledged.
expected_result: Complaint status changes to Acknowledged and student is notified.

purpose: Verify that a student can request an extended stay.
preconditions: Student authenticated; current stay end date approaching.
action_or_input: Submit an extended‑stay request with new end date.
expected_result: Request is recorded and pending approval.

purpose: Validate that a Super Admin can publish a hostel‑wide announcement.
preconditions: Super Admin authenticated.
action_or_input: Create announcement content and publish it.
expected_result: Announcement is visible to all users in the announcements feed.

purpose: Check that publishing an announcement respects role permissions.
preconditions: Caretaker authenticated; attempts to publish announcement.
action_or_input: Attempt to publish announcement.
expected_result: System rejects the action with an authorization error.

purpose: Ensure that a student can view their fine history.
preconditions: Student logged in; at least one fine previously recorded.
action_or_input: Open the "Fine History" page.
expected_result: List of past fines with statuses and amounts is displayed.

purpose: Validate that a caretaker can generate a guard shift report.
preconditions: Caretaker authenticated.
action_or_input: Request shift report for a specific date range.
expected_result: Report PDF with shift details is generated and downloadable.

purpose: Confirm that a student can submit a room‑maintenance request.
preconditions: Student logged in; room assigned.
action_or_input: Fill maintenance request form and submit.
expected_result: Request is logged and maintenance team receives notification.

purpose: Validate that a caretaker can update room‑maintenance request status.
preconditions: Caretaker authenticated; maintenance request in 'Open' state.
action_or_input: Change status to 'In Progress' and add notes.
expected_result: Request status updates and notes are saved.

purpose: Ensure that a student receives a notification when their room‑maintenance request is completed.
preconditions: Student logged in; request status changed to 'Completed'.
action_or_input: Check notifications page.
expected_result: Notification about completed maintenance is displayed.

purpose: Validate that a Super Admin can deactivate a hostel record.
preconditions: Super Admin authenticated; hostel currently active.
action_or_input: Select the hostel and trigger deactivation.
expected_result: Hostel status changes to Inactive and related access is revoked.
